spans.s: --a son of the elephant मृग. Br.

(अन्याङ्गनारति s.v.)--बृहस्पति tells Indra that intercourse with mother, sister, wife of pre- ceptor and uncle's wife is illegal. The last two could be atoned for by a कृच्छ्र of १२ and 6 years respectively. Simi- lar cases of forbidden intercourse and their respective प्रा- यश्चित्तस् given. Repetition of पञ्चदशाक्षरी 1008 times after worshipping पराशक्ति could remove all sins. Br.
--the forest in the Kuru country between the two mountains चन्द्रकान्त and सूर्यकान्त. वा. ४५. ३१.
(I)--a son of Pulastya and हविर्भू: he was Dahra-agni in his previous birth. भा., IV, 1. ३६.

(II)--a contemporary of कृष्ण and राम; and a resident of Mount Malaya. Visited by बलराम.
1: भा., X. ७९. १७.
Came to स्यमन्तपञ्चक to see कृष्ण.
2: Ib. X. ८४. 5.
Called on परीक्षित् prac- tising प्रायोपवेश.
3: Ib. I. १९. १०.
[page१-008+ ४२]

(IV)--married the first born daughter of King Malayadhvaja पाण्ड्य, and had a son दृढाच्युत.
1: भा. IV. २८. ३२.
Cursed the पाण्ड्यन् king Indradyumna to become an elephant.
2: Ib.
(V)--the constellation (Canopus) that moves fast above ध्रुवमण्डल. Br. II. २१. १०१; वा. ५०, १५५. [page१-009+ २६]

(III)--born from a pitcher into which Mitra and वरुण dropped their वीर्य at the sight of the charms of उर्वशी: a brother of वसिष्ठ.
1: भा. VI. १८. 5; Br.

. ३८ M. ६१. २१-31; २०१. २९; २०२. 1.
Dwarfed the Vindhyas, made a home in लङ्का: seeing the universe troubled by तारक and other Asuras caused the ocean to dry up by drinking the waters and brought relief to the Devas: performed तपस् seated on Mount Malaya with his wife लोपामुद्रा: white in colour, with four hands, अक्ष माला and कमण्डलु, narrated the story of अजामिल:
2: भा.,

. ३५; M. ६१. १७; ३६-41; Br. III. ५६. ५३.
pre- sent at राम's अभिषेक.
2: (a) Vi. IV 4. ९९.
Visited by परशुराम, initiated him to the कृष्णप्रेमामृतम् mantra which he heard from शेष, the नाग king. Spoke to him of the threefold भक्ति and its characteristics.
3: Br. II, ३२. ११९; III. ३४. ५०; ३५. ३४, ४१, ४८; ३६, 1-५९; ३७, 2; ५६. २३.
A ब्रह्मिष्ठ, versed in वैखानस; a देवऋषि, versed in Vedic literature.
4: M. १४५. ९३, ११४.
The guest of Ilvala who cooked वातापि for him.
5: भा. VI. १८, १५.
Roaming about, he found all creatures engrossed in ignorance. Reaching काञ्ची, he prayed to कामाक्षि and एकाम्रशिव. Here हयग्रीव Vis2n2u appeared before him and pointed out ways to redeem the ignorant millions. Was entertained with the story of शक्ति by हयग्रीव.
6: Br.

: M. १३३. ६७.
He who worships Agastya becomes lord of the seven worlds.
8: M. ६१. ४४-55.
--in the Udayantaka Mt.; here eight sages performed austerities and attained salvation. वा. १०८. ४५.

--the ब्रह्मराक्षसस्--a clan moving about in the night;
1: Br.

. ५९ and ६२; वा. ६९. १९५-6.
of Surabhi forest;
2: M. १२१. ६२.
summoned Kauberaka to live at हरिशृङ्ग.
3: वा. ४७. ६०-1.
--Father of four sons and a daughter. Br. III. ७१. २५७.
--a son of Vasudeva and वृकदेवी a महात्मा। Br. III. ७१. १८०.

1: Vi. I. १७. ५८.
--the rules of;
2: Br. II. ३०. १९ and २७; III. २१. ४६.
for digging wells, constructing tanks and gardens;
3: M. ५८. ५५; १४३. १३.
cited for यज्ञस् where पशु was not involved and where बीज (seeds) served the purpose of the animal.
